ytterbite: A ytterbite is a mineral that is a source of rare earths.
Ytterbite means the same as gadolinite.
ytterbium: A ytterbium is a soft silvery metallic element.
Ytterbium means the same as Yb or atomic number 70.
yttrium: A yttrium is a silvery metallic element that is common in rare-earth minerals.
Yttrium means the same as Y or atomic number 39.
